chapter: Ch. 4 — The Anatomy of an AI Workload
evidence: the 9.2K prefill is ≈1.19 PFLOPS of work at 140 GFLOP/token sustained over 1.08 s (9,200 × 140 GFLOP ÷ 1.08 s)
issue: Unit mismatch: PFLOPS is a rate, not an amount of work. The displayed expression first yields ≈1.29 PFLOP of prefill work, then dividing by 1.08 s yields ≈1.19 PFLOPS as the required compute rate.
fix_instruction: Replace '≈1.19 PFLOPS of work' with '≈1.29 PFLOP of work, implying ≈1.19 PFLOPS of required compute rate over 1.08 s', and keep the existing expression as the rate derivation.
